status: Engineering formation implementation under test; no new GPU/model run and no admission

motivation.primary: adaptive allocation rejected: -5.85% quality score despite lower search cost
motivation.observed_issue: 12 correctness failures of the same frozen central-variance artifact across three arms and two configurations/repeats; not twelve independent learning/forgetting events
motivation.inference: An old successful implementation can become invalid under fresh cases. Archive both failures and changed successful descendants; do not extrapolate failure to all inputs.

scope: Automatic formation from verified complete research episodes, including failed independent finals
Verified parent snapshot activation, initial result identity, actual first artifact action and changed agent-proposed source
Content-addressed records and snapshots; full raw ancestry re-audit, bounded to32 records
No promotion, active pointer, model calls or additional measurement in collection
Same parent/scope/source yields same proposal_key regardless of changed episode receipts; future admission must consume it once
unchanged: Oracle, fixed baseline, performance tolerance, evaluator protocol, action limits, source validator and GPU admission
Rejected adaptive m/n outcome and untouched closed o/p
Foreground one bounded snapshot read; no archive traversal or collector in foreground
publication_and_value_remaining: Controlled child-versus-parent validation on fresh configured cases with old-skill retention, original gates and complete costs
One-attempt admission keyed by proposal identity, atomic active transition, stale-parent protection, audit revocation and rollback
Actual automatically formed and admitted generation1 andgeneration2 compared to no-memory and frozen generation0 controls under a distinct frozen protocol
Independent final efficacy confirmation, no cherry-picked old winner, no threshold relaxation

reference_mapping.lesson: Keep raw candidate outcomes and explicit parent-child archive; retain rejected candidates without granting adoption.
Bind executed evidence to source and harness; cached formation is not a new evaluation or gain.
Formation, activation, improvement and retention are separate claims.

amendment: The previous conditional plan allowed production publisher consideration only after adaptive efficacy. That candidate failed and is closed. This is a different artifact-update mechanism motivated by frozen-library failures, developed as disabled research infrastructure. Production activation still requires independent efficacy evidence; no prerequisite is silently declared satisfied.
